examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: بقول لهم: 'يا جماعة، تشربوا إيه؟ عندي ثلاث كوبايات شاي حلوين.'
examples.english: I tell them: 'Guys, what do you want to drink? I have three nice cups of tea.'
examples.transliteration: Ba2ul lehom: 'Ya gama3a, teshrabo eh? 3andy talat kobbayat shay 7elween.'

examples.english: Nour suggested: "Should we bring tea and cake?"
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: شربنا شاي سخن وأكلنا شوية حلويات مع جيراننا.
examples.english: We drank hot tea and ate some sweets with our neighbors.
examples.transliteration: Sherebna shay sokhn wa akalna shwayet halawiyat ma'a geranna.

examples.arabic: الحمد لله انا كويس وبشرب شاي الصبح
examples.english: Thank God I am good and drinking tea in the morning.
examples.transliteration: elhamdullelah ana kwayes wa bashrab shay el sobh

examples.arabic: انا بشرب شاي الصبح في البيت
examples.english: I drink tea in the morning in the house
examples.transliteration: Ana bashrab shay el sobh fel beit
